data.description: The figure provides detailed information about a cement job in well 56-32. It includes the start date and time, job type, well section, and wellbore details. The primary job detail section lists volumes of conditioning data, cement data, displacement data, and calculated displacement volume along with corresponding pump times and rates. The slurry information specifies the density, yield, sacks used, and volume of the cement mixture, as well as additives used in the mix. Post-job information includes a liner top test result and job success status.
